title: Grow Room Blueprint Lab
summary: Build a simple training-room footprint, calculate floor area, and document where measurements, airflow observations, access paths and equipment zones would need verification before any real design decision.

steps.instruction: Enter the training-room length and width.
Identify a crop zone, access path, environmental measurement zone and equipment influence zone.
List the measurements or qualified design inputs still required before a real facility decision.

boundary: Training geometry only. This lab does not size HVAC, electrical, structural, fire/life-safety, compressed-gas, irrigation or code-required systems and is not an engineering design.
